what: Musician states that no Patreon "creators" were consulted or notified about the Apple-driven billing model change; describes it as presented to creators as a "fait accompli."
verbatim_snippet: "It appears that no Patreon 'creators' were consulted or notified of this (I was not, and none of the fellow creators that I know were either); rather it was presented to us by Patreon as a fait accompli"
date: Accessed April 2026; page undated. Post references upcoming November 2025 billing deadline, suggesting authorship between April and November 2025.
notes: Patreon.com returned 403 on direct fetch; passage visible in Google search index of the same URL. source_type classified as "blog" (self-published creator content); Patreon posts are functionally equivalent to blog posts though hosted on the platform under study — ambiguity noted. Author is Mitch Benn (musician/comedian). A separate passage from the same post states: "Patreon have evidently decided that their relationship with Apple is more important than their relationship with creators."
